integrity: All-length combinatorial proof supplied in RESULT.md; standalone executable finite diagnostic checker.py enumerates \(3\le n\le9\), tests 783 ordered path distances through \(n=8\). Neither computational tests nor the same-model review constitute independent proof certification.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one descent, adjacent-position transpositions, distinct labels and finite \(n\ge3\); no claim for higher descent counts, nonadjacent swaps, cyclic positions or disconnected-state global distances. A scalar isolated-state formula already occurs in OEIS for a different object; the proposed contribution is the graph structure. Historical priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: Exact component geometry of the one-descent permutation swap graph
